title: JPL counter clerk hands over negatives of "the old city on Mars"

tellings.quote: he went oh this is the old city on Mars

plain: Sometime in the 1980s, a counter clerk at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, a space research laboratory in California, handed over photographic negatives from the mapping of Mars and said, "oh this is the old city on Mars." Joe McMoneagle, who says he was the one standing at that counter, tells it to Michels. If it happened as he says, it would mean that staff at the lab casually treated a city on Mars as known.
